$description: The development tasks and targets from proposals/2026-10-02-media-text-and-recipe-parity.md. This file is the source; tasks.md and examples/tasks.html are rendered from it by render-tasks.mjs. Edit here, then run `node proposals/2026-10-02-media-text-and-recipe-parity/render-tasks.mjs`. Decisions and their options are in `decisions`; rulings are recorded append-only in rulings.json and applied by apply-rulings.mjs, never by editing task statuses here.

statuses.done: Built and verified in this change; reviewable now.
statuses.blocked: Waits on another task or a release.
statuses.ruling: Waits on a decision by Meridian (open-issues.md).
statuses.dropped: No longer wanted, by a ruling; kept so the record shows why.

priorities.P0: Ships with the next core release; correctness or accessibility.
priorities.P1: The brief's own asks, or what makes them shippable.
priorities.P2: Consistency and coverage the brief implies.
priorities.P3: Worth doing; nothing waits on it.

decisions.summary: Crystal React ships RichTextEditor from @crystal-ui/react/editor, binding TipTap 3 to Crystal's format vocabulary with TipTap as optional peers. decisions.title: Selection that travels between segments
decisions.summary: When the choice changes in tabs, a segmented control, the dock, bottom navigation or a toggle button group, the old segment's fill switches off and the new one's switches on: Crystal paints selection on each item, and the only motion is selection's squash in place (tab-in plays on the panel, not the tab). surfaces.json describes .cr-indicator as "the moving pill behind a selected segment", but crystal.css draws no such pill, and no recipe moves a selection from one place to another. A travelling pill is motion a person starts, so the rule that nothing moves at rest allows it; it is a visible change to every strip, so it is Meridian's to approve.

options.label: Specify a travelling pill for every strip: one .cr-indicator.pill behind the selected segment, moved by a new critically damped recipe between measured positions, on tabs, the segmented control, the dock, bottom navigation and toggle button groups; selection stays label weight

task.target: crystal.css has .cr-indicator.pill, the strips draw selection on it rather than per item, motion-recipes.json has a critically damped selection-travel recipe driven by measured layout (instant under reduced motion), and extend-catalogue-9.cjs assigns it to tabs, segmented-control, dock, bottom-navigation and button-group, each measured on a component first. The preview is re-baselined with every changed frame disclosed.
